findings: StripDebugInfo is an optional non-optimization pass, so MIR opt-level=0 does not suppress it when explicitly enabled.
For normal function instances, the collector requests instance_mir -> optimized_mir; the latter runs the pass. It is after borrow checking but before the collector examines that function's MIR.
The pass retains argument VarDebugInfo entries and drops other local debug entries, plus invalid statement debug records. It does not remove local_decls or the type/query arenas.

Body.var_debug_info is Vec<VarDebugInfo>; retain reduces length without shrinking its retained backing capacity. Dropped nested composite debug boxes/projection vectors can release some memory, but no actual allocation-size evidence is available.
The collector visits var_debug_info only under DebugInfo::Full. The measured invocation uses -C debuginfo=0, so that direct debug-info mono traversal is already skipped.
mir_strip_assessment.conclusion: Timing is potentially relevant for the later failure, but evidence does not establish a material RSS reduction for this exact command. Do not spend another full build solely on this flag.
